headline: A 2019 law renames a Postal Service building in Whittier, California, as the Jose Ramos Post Office Building.
what_it_does: The law names a specific United States Postal Service facility at 8520 Michigan Avenue in Whittier, California, the Jose Ramos Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 13, 2019.
